Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_91005
▸ SWS_EcuM_00624 [SWS_EcuM_00624] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_00624])
Konstituierend · requirement

The EcuM_SelectShutdownTarget function shall set the shut- down target to the value of the shutdownTarget parameter.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_00624
▸ SWS_EcuM_01117 [SWS_EcuM_01117] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_01117])
Konstituierend · requirement

EcuM_SetWakeupEvent sets (OR-operation) all events passed as a bit set in the sources in parameter ( EcuM_WakeupSourceType bitmask) in the internal pending wakeup events variable.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_01117
▸ SWS_EcuM_01156 [SWS_EcuM_01156] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_01156])
Konstituierend · requirement

EcuM_GetPendingWakeupEvents shall return wakeup events which have been set to pending but not yet validated as bits set in a EcuM_- WakeupSourceType bitmask.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_01156
▸ SWS_EcuM_02156 [SWS_EcuM_02156] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02156])
Konstituierend · requirement

EcuM_GetLastShutdownTarget shall return the ECU state from which the last wakeup or power up occurred in the shutdownTarget parameter. EcuM_ GetLastShutdownTarget shall always return the same value until the next shutdown.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02156
▸ SWS_EcuM_02157 [SWS_EcuM_02157] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02157])
Konstituierend · requirement

EcuM_GetLastShutdownTarget may return a shutdown target in a STARTUP phase that set late in a previous SHUTDOWN phase. If so, implementation specific limitations shall be clearly documented.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02157
▸ SWS_EcuM_02165 [SWS_EcuM_02165] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02165])
Konstituierend · requirement

Additional wakeup sources (to the pre-defined sources) shall be assigned individually to bitfield positions 5 to 31 by configuration. The bit assignment shall be done by the configuration tool.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02165
▸ SWS_EcuM_02166 [SWS_EcuM_02166] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02166])
Konstituierend · requirement

The EcuMWakeupSourceId (see ECUC_EcuM_00151) field in the EcuMWakeupSource container shall define the position corresponding to that wakeup source in all instances the EcuM_WakeupSourceType bitfield.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02166
▸ SWS_EcuM_02171 [SWS_EcuM_02171] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02171])
Konstituierend · requirement

EcuM_SetWakeupEvent must be callable from interrupt con- text, from OS context and an OS-free context.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02171
▸ SWS_EcuM_02172 [SWS_EcuM_02172] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02172])
Konstituierend · requirement

EcuM_GetPendingWakeupEvents shall be callable from in- terrupt context, from OS context and an OS-free context.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02172
▸ SWS_EcuM_02181 [SWS_EcuM_02181] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02181])
Konstituierend · requirement

The ECU Manager module shall call EcuM_GetValidated- WakeupEvents with the configured default shutdown target ( EcuMDefaultShut- downTarget ).

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02181
▸ SWS_EcuM_02185 [SWS_EcuM_02185] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02185])
Konstituierend · requirement

The parameter mode of the function EcuM_SelectShutdown Target shall be the identifier of a sleep or reset mode. The mode parameter shall only be used if the target parameter equals ECUM_SHUTDOWN_TARGET_SLEEP or ECUM_SHUTDOWN_TARGET_RESET. In all other cases, it shall be ignored. Only sleep or reset modes that are defined at configuration time and are stored in the Ecu MCommonConfiguration container (see ECUC_EcuM_00181) are allowed as parame- ters.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02185
▸ SWS_EcuM_02188 [SWS_EcuM_02188] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02188])
Konstituierend · requirement

No wakeup event shall be missed in the SLEEP phase. The Halt or Poll Sequences shall not be entered if a wakeup event has occurred in the Go Sleep sequence.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02188
▸ SWS_EcuM_02247 [SWS_EcuM_02247] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02247])
Konstituierend · requirement

The service EcuM_SelectBootTarget shall store the se- lected target in a way that is compatible with the boot loader.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02247
▸ SWS_EcuM_02336 [SWS_EcuM_02336] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02336])
Konstituierend · requirement

If the call of GetLastShutdownTarget() passes ECU_STATE_ SLEEP in the parameter shutdownTarget, in the parameter shutdownMode it returns which of the configured sleep modes was actually chosen. 112 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 If the call of GetLastShutdownTarget() passes ECU_STATE_RESET in the parameter shutdownTarget, in the parameter sleepMode it returns which of the configured reset modes was actually chosen.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02336
▸ SWS_EcuM_02337 [SWS_EcuM_02337] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02337])
Konstituierend · requirement

If the pointer to the shutdownMode parameter is NULL, Ecu M_GetLastShutdownTarget shall simply ignore the shutdownMode parameter and re- turn the last shutdown target regardless of whether it was SLEEP or not. If Develop- ment Error Detection is activated, EcuM_GetShutdownTarget shall send the ECUM_ E_PARAM_POINTER development error to the DET module.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02337
▸ SWS_EcuM_02345 [SWS_EcuM_02345] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02345])
Konstituierend · requirement

EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent shall be callable from interrupt context and task context.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02345
▸ SWS_EcuM_02389 [SWS_EcuM_02389] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02389])
Konstituierend · requirement

To set the wakeup sources up for the next sleep mode, the ECU Manager module shall execute the EcuM_EnableWakeupSources callout (see [SWS_EcuM_02546] ) for each wakeup source that is configured in EcuMWakeup- SourceMask for the target sleep mode.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02389
▸ SWS_EcuM_02411 [SWS_EcuM_02411] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02411])
Konstituierend · requirement

Table StartPreOS Sequence shows the activities in StartPre OS Sequence and the order in which they shall be executed in EcuM_Init (see [SWS_EcuM_02811] ).

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02411
▸ SWS_EcuM_02479 [SWS_EcuM_02479] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02479])
Konstituierend · requirement

The ECU Manager module shall execute the Wakeup Valida- tion Protocol upon the EcuM_SetWakeupEvent (see [SWS_EcuM_02826] ) function call according to Interaction of Wakeup Sources and the ECU Manager later in this chapter.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02479
▸ SWS_EcuM_02496 [SWS_EcuM_02496] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02496])
Konstituierend · requirement

If the wakeup event is validated (either immediately or by the wakeup validation protocol), the ECU Manager module shall make the information that it is a source of the current ECU wakeup through the EcuM_GetValidatedWakeu- pEvents (see [SWS_EcuM_02830] ) function.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02496
▸ SWS_EcuM_02532 [SWS_EcuM_02532] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02532])
Konstituierend · requirement

EcuM_GetValidatedWakeupEvent shall be callable from in- terrupt context, from OS context and an OS-free context.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02532
▸ SWS_EcuM_02533 [SWS_EcuM_02533] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02533])
Konstituierend · requirement

EcuM_GetValidatedWakeupEvent shall return wakeup events which have been set to validated in the internal validated events variable as bits set in a EcuM_WakeupSourceType bitmask.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02533
▸ SWS_EcuM_02539 [SWS_EcuM_02539] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02539])
Konstituierend · requirement

If the ECU Manager module has a list of wakeup source can- didates when the WakeupRestart Sequence has finished, the ECU Manager module shall validate these wakeup source candidates in EcuM_MainFunction .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02539
▸ SWS_EcuM_02546 [SWS_EcuM_02546] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02546])
Konstituierend · requirement

The ECU Manager module shall derive the wakeup sources to be enabled (and used as the wakeupSource parameter) from the EcuMWakeupSource (see ECUC_EcuM_00152) bitfield configured for the current sleep mode.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02546
▸ SWS_EcuM_02559 [SWS_EcuM_02559] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02559])
Konstituierend · requirement

The configuration of the ECU Manager module shall spec- ify the order of initialization calls inside init block 0 and init block 1. (see EcuM- DriverInitListZero and EcuMDriverInitListOne ).

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02559
▸ SWS_EcuM_02561 [SWS_EcuM_02561] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02561])
Konstituierend · requirement

The ECU Manager module shall initialize the drivers in Ecu MDriverRestartList in the same order as in the combined list of init block 0 and init block 1.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02561
▸ SWS_EcuM_02562 [SWS_EcuM_02562] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02562])
Konstituierend · requirement

EcuMDriverRestartList may contain drivers that serve as wakeup sources. EcuM_AL_DriverRestart shall re-arm the trigger mechanism of these drivers' 'wakeup detected' callback.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02562
▸ SWS_EcuM_02565 [SWS_EcuM_02565] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02565])
Konstituierend · requirement

The ECU Manager module shall start a validation timeout for each pending wakeup event that should be validated. The timeout shall be event- specific (see EcuMValidationTimeout ).

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02565
▸ SWS_EcuM_02566 [SWS_EcuM_02566] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02566])
Konstituierend · requirement

The ECU Manager module shall only invoke wakeup validation on those wakeup sources where it is required by configuration. If the validation protocol 60 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 is not configured (see EcuMValidationTimeout ), then a call to EcuM_SetWakeu- pEvent shall also imply a call to EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02566
▸ SWS_EcuM_02572 [SWS_EcuM_02572] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02572])
Konstituierend · requirement

The ECU Manager module shall detect wakeups that occurr prior to driver initialization, both from Halt/Poll or from OFF.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02572
▸ SWS_EcuM_02585 [SWS_EcuM_02585] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02585])
Konstituierend · requirement

EcuM_SelectShutdownTarget shall not initiate any setup activi- ties but only store the value for later use in the SHUTDOWN or SLEEP phase.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02585
▸ SWS_EcuM_02589 [SWS_EcuM_02589] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02589])
Konstituierend · requirement

EcuM_GetExpiredWakeupEvents shall be callable from in- terrupt context, from OS context and an OS-free context.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02589
▸ SWS_EcuM_02601 [SWS_EcuM_02601] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02601])
Konstituierend · requirement

If the EcuM cannot determine the reset reason returned by the Mcu driver, then the EcuM set a wakeup event for default wakeup source ECUM_ WKSOURCE_RESET instead.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02601
▸ SWS_EcuM_02603 [SWS_EcuM_02603] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02603])
Konstituierend · requirement

The StartPreOS Sequence shall initialize all basic software modules that are needed to start the OS.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02603
▸ SWS_EcuM_02623 [SWS_EcuM_02623] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02623])
Konstituierend · requirement

The ECU Manager module shall remember the wakeup source resulting from the reset reason translation (see table StartPreOS Sequence ).

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_EcuM_02623
▸ SWS_EcuM_02625 [SWS_EcuM_02625] requirement ECUM
Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02625])
Konstituierend · requirement

The ECU Manager module shall invoke the EcuM_Generat- eRamHash (see [SWS_EcuM_02919] ) callout before halting the microcontroller the 49 of 210 Document ID 78: AUTOSAR_SWS_ECUStateManager Specification of ECU State Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 EcuM_CheckRamHash (see [SWS_EcuM_02921] ) callout after the processor returns from halt. In case of applied multi core and existence of "slave" EcuM(s) this check should be executed on the "master" EcuM only. The "master" EcuM generates the hash out of all data that lie within its reach. Private data of "slave" EcuMs are out of scope.

In contrast to the SHUTDOWN phase, the ECU Manager mod- ule shall not shut down the OS when entering the SLEEP phase. The sleep mode, i.e. combination of the EcuM SLEEP phase and the Mcu Mode, shall be transparent to the OS.

Unbewertet

Unbewertet

The shutdown hook shall call EcuM_Shutdown (see [SWS_EcuM_02812] ) to terminate the shutdown process. EcuM_Shutdown (see [SWS_EcuM_02812] ) shall not return but switch off the ECU or issue a reset.

Unbewertet

The ECU Manager module may define a configurable set of sleep modes (see EcuMSleepMode ) where each mode itself is a shutdown target.

Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02958])
Konstituierend · requirement

The ECU Manager module shall allow mapping the MCU sleep modes to ECU sleep modes and hence allow them to be addressed as shutdown tar- gets.

Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02960])
Konstituierend · requirement

The ECU Manager module shall execute the Halt Sequence in sleep modes that halt the microcontroller. In these sleep modes the ECU Manager module does not execute any code.

Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02962])
Konstituierend · requirement

The ECU Manager module shall execute the Poll Sequence in sleep modes that reduce the power consumption of the microcontroller but still execute code.

Unbewertet
ECUM ([SWS_EcuM_02963])
Konstituierend · requirement

If a wakeup event (e.g. toggling a wakeup line, communication on a CAN bus etc.) occurs while the ECU is in Halt or Poll, then the ECU Manager module shall regain control and exit the SLEEP phase by executing the WakeupRestart sequence. An ISR may be invoked to handle the wakeup event, but this depends on the hardware and the driver implementation.

Unbewertet

If a wakeup event does not require validation, the ECU Man- ager module shall issue a mode switch request to set the event's mode to ECUM_ WKSTATUS_VALIDATED.

Unbewertet

Unbewertet

The integration code used for this callout must determine which wakeup sources must be checked.

Konstituierend · requirement

Mode changes shall be notified to SW-Cs through the RTE mode ports when the mode change occurs. This specification assumes that the port name is currentMode and that the direct API of RTE will be used. Under these conditions mode changes signaled by invoking Rte_StatusType Rte_Switch_currentMode_currentMode( Rte_ModeType_EcuM_Mode mode) where mode is the new mode to be notified. The value range is specified by the previ- ous requirement. The return value shall be ignored. A SW-C which wants to be notified of mode changes should require the mode switch interface EcuM_CurrentMode.
